title: The backward problem for a multi-term time-fractional diffusion equation
summary: This paper is devoted to the investigation of the backward problem for a multi-term time-fractional diffusion equation. Backward problems for fractional diffusion equations are typically studied using regularization methods due to their ill-posedness in the sense of Hadamard; that is, a small change in u(T) may lead to large changes in the initial data. Nevertheless, we show that if sufficiently smooth current data are considered, then the solution exists, is unique, and is stable.
